videos.title: GTA 6 Unlocks in Waves Today — Here's When You Can Play ⏰ #gta6 #shorts
videos.description:
GTA 6 reportedly unlocks at local midnight in waves over about 19 hours: New Zealand first (6 a.m. ET on Nov 18), with the US and Canada together at midnight ET (9 p.m. PT on Nov 18). Unlock follows your account region; Rockstar hasn't confirmed every time, so check your store page.

Sources: PlayStation Store listings via GTAVice.net, Vice, Notebookcheck, Dexerto, Rockstar Support

videos.title: The Weather Channel Just Posted a GTA 6 Forecast 🌩️ #gta6 #shorts
videos.description:
On Nov 16, The Weather Channel shared six official GTA 6 screenshots from Rockstar, each with an in-world forecast for Leonida: heavy rain, tropical storms and sea fog. Rockstar says the weather is local and dynamic, so it can storm in the Keys while Vice City stays clear.

Sources: The Weather Channel (X), Dot Esports, G2A News, Game Informer

videos.title: GTA 6 Standard or Ultimate? The Quick Breakdown 💰 #gta6 #shorts
videos.description:
GTA 6 Standard Edition is $79.99 (digital or disc) and the Ultimate Edition is $99.99 (digital only) with extra vehicles, weapons, outfits and businesses. Early buyers of either edition get the Vintage Vice City Pack: a '55 Vapid Stanier, a garage, outfits and an exclusive weapon pattern.

Sources: Rockstar Games Support, Insider Gaming, TheSixthAxis, Inven Global
